title: Make the fixes/lib suite fast without weakening it
objective: Cut the suite from 110s to well under a minute so pre-push stops being dominated by it, changing only how long things wait and how the PATH shim farm is built.
acceptance_criteria: run_all.sh completes in under 60s and exits 0.
The assertion count is unchanged at 645 OK with 0 FAIL; no test is deleted, skipped or weakened.
The cases that depend on a tool being genuinely unfindable still pass, so the shim farm is still doing its job.
Every touched file stays under the 250-line cap and shellcheck-clean with zero suppressions.
thorium_repairs.sh's production wait is unchanged by default: THORIUM_STARTUP_WAIT defaults to the original 4.
out_of_scope: The coverage jail's own runtime, which is dominated by kcov and runs two passes by design.
The pacman_hook_stall harness, which predates lib_test_core.sh.
verifier: time bash linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/fixes/lib/tests/run_all.sh (expects exit 0 in under 60s), plus `bash run_all.sh | grep -c '^  OK'` returning 645 and `grep -c '^  FAIL'` returning 0.
